key_insight: XGBoost predicted HDPE friction stir spot weld fracture loads and identified a descriptive high-performance region, but not a unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: Condition-aware machine learning can guide selection of promising welding settings while accounting for prediction uncertainty.
method: Compared six regression approaches using 20 repeated group-aware train/test splits.
Used grouped permutation importance and SHAP to assess parameter contributions and interactions.
Evaluated uncertainty with group-separated split-conformal intervals.
evidence_signal: Across 258 observations covering 230 unique input conditions, XGBoost achieved R² = 0.823 ± 0.064 and RMSE = 413.0 ± 79.5 N.
watch_item: Wide uncertainty intervals and prediction errors exceeding differences among leading conditions limit precise ranking; the identified region applies only to experimentally represented conditions.
paper_title: Machine-learning prediction of lap-shear fracture load and identification of high-performance conditions in HDPE friction stir spot welding
